output.summary: A yellow-green succulent shrub found worldwide; in New England, subspecies richii is native, while subspecies maritima is introduced. Its fleshy leaves turn red when they absorb too much salt. Young leaves can be eaten raw or cooked, though strongly salty, and seeds can also be eaten either way; protected populations may not be harvested.
output.edibilityNote: Young leaves and seeds are eaten raw or cooked; the leaves are strongly salty, and protected populations may not be harvested.
